mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS report_id, s.id AS session_id, s.title, s.started_at, s.ended_at, r.status, r.summary, r.avg_viewers, r.peak_viewers, r.total_chat, r.analyzed_chat, r.joy_count, r.excitement_count, r.support_count, r.surprise_count, r.sadness_count, r.anger_count, r.confusion_count, r.neutral_count, r.generated_at, s.category, s.language, GREATEST(0, floor(extract(epoch FROM (s.ended_at - s.started_at)) / 60))::bigint AS duration_minutes, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_gaps g WHERE g.session_id = s.id) AS has_collection_gap FROM reports r JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE r.id = #{reportId} AND s.id = #{sessionId}

SELECT id AS trigger_id, session_id, trigger_type, transcript_id, start_ms, end_ms, peak_z, peak_engagement, avg_viewers, chat_count, unique_chatters, analyzed_chat, joy_count, excitement_count, support_count, surprise_count, sadness_count, anger_count, confusion_count, neutral_count, narrative, screen_context, analysis_status FROM triggers WHERE id = #{triggerId}
UPDATE triggers SET analysis_status = 'PENDING', analysis_error = NULL WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND analysis_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE triggers SET narrative = #{narrative}, analyzed_at = #{analyzedAt}, analysis_status = 'COMPLETED', analysis_error = NULL WHERE id = #{triggerId} AND analysis_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.id FROM triggers t JOIN risk_events r ON r.session_id = t.session_id AND r.detected_at >= t.started_at AND r.detected_at < t.ended_at WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_insights (report_id, title, content) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{insight.title}, #{insight.content})

INSERT INTO highlights (report_id, trigger_id, start_ms, end_ms) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{highlight.triggerId}, #{highlight.startMs}, #{highlight.endMs}) ON CONFLICT (report_id, trigger_id) WHERE trigger_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET start_ms = EXCLUDED.start_ms, end_ms = EXCLUDED.end_ms
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
